message: We've all been there—suddenly the lights go out and the world outside goes quiet. Instead of panicking, I like to think of it as an opportunity to slow down and enjoy some cozy time at home. The Red Cross has some great tips on how to prepare for power outages, so you can turn that unexpected blackout into a warm gathering with family or a chance to dive into that book you've been meaning to read. What’s your favorite way to pass the time when the power goes out?
